scientific_question: Is the intended RH-006 equal-accuracy null global over the full finite-sample quadratic surface, or local over a scientifically bounded effect/risk neighborhood?

exact_branch_conditioning.interpretation: sqrt(D) is the absolute radial derivative of the null surface along the ray
exact_branch_conditioning.policy: D<0 means unsupported; D near zero means critical branch sensitivity; both positive roots must be retained if present

effect_coordinate.G: mean held-out feature Gram matrix G=average_o(Z_test_o' Z_test_o / TEST)
effect_coordinate.sigma_ref: frozen reference innovation/residual scale declared by analysis plan
effect_coordinate.reason: measures induced outcome-space perturbation rather than arbitrary coefficient magnitude

radius_policy.rule: The ladder is exploratory only. A formal local null radius must be fixed prospectively from the scientific estimand and cannot be selected by rejection behavior.

continuous_inversion_strategy.preferred: Represent the full admissible quadratic surface in canonical/eigen coordinates and invert a valid test over the set.
continuous_inversion_strategy.numerical_guard: Use ray root-finding only as an analytic parameterization; use adaptive/approximation-controlled coverage diagnostics rather than treating an arbitrary finite grid as the inferential set.
continuous_inversion_strategy.reason: Recent weak-identification confidence-set work documents that ordinary grid inversion can miss disconnected components and truncate unbounded regions; polynomial structure can support more reliable inversion. This is methodological precedent, not a ready-made RH-006 estimator bridge.

candidate_calibration_routes.purpose: invert a valid test over the entire admissible local/global surface
candidate_calibration_routes.weak_identification_status: candidate only; requires valid test and estimator bridge

required_falsification.radius_support_curve: For every frozen radius, report the fraction of surface branches represented inside that radius.
required_falsification.branch_sensitivity: Report discriminant and normalized radial-derivative conditioning by radius stratum.
required_falsification.component_recovery: Demonstrate that disconnected/unbounded surface components are not lost by the numerical representation.
required_falsification.parameterization_invariance: Equivalent coefficient parameterizations must yield equivalent effect-radius classification.
required_falsification.identification_stress: Compare regular, near-flat, and critical strata under explicit weak-identification DGPs.
required_falsification.nuisance_stratification: Compare oracle and estimated-nuisance calibration within each geometry stratum.

external_literature.citation: Schlemper and Moreira (2026), Confidence Sets under Weak Identification: Theory and Practice
external_literature.relevance: Exact/controlled inversion of polynomial or rational test geometry; warning that ordinary grids can miss components.

external_literature.citation: Andrews and Cheng (2012), Estimation and Inference With Weak, Semi-Strong, and Strong Identification
external_literature.relevance: Weak-identification robustness as an explicit uniform-in-identification requirement.

external_literature.citation: Hill (2021), Weak-Identification Robust Wild Bootstrap Applied to a Consistent Model Specification Test
external_literature.relevance: Identification-state targeted bootstrap and uniform-size motivation; RH-006 requires a new derivation because the statistical object differs.

external_literature.citation: Giacomini and White (2006), Tests of Conditional Predictive Ability
external_literature.relevance: Forecast evaluation with estimation uncertainty and general estimation procedures.

external_literature.citation: Clark and McCracken (2015), Nested forecast model comparisons: A new approach to testing equal accuracy
external_literature.relevance: Finite-sample equal-accuracy null with weak nonzero nested coefficients; rolling estimation included.

execution_gate.next: execute effect-radius support curves and branch-conditioning strata, then compare candidate robust calibration routes without selecting a radius from results

nonclaims: No claim that any exploratory radius is the final scientific locality threshold.
